summary: The three audits now dispatch index-free verifiers before required(index) can throw, so an index failure orphans them
evidence: audit-prd.js:140 dispatches, :198 calls required(index) which throws; same shape at audit-trd.js:174/:255 and audit-build.js:186/:245. The promise is only awaited later (:267/:348/:318). An index stage returning nothing fails the run either way, so the cost is an unhandled rejection warning plus wasted in-flight agents — accepted deliberately as the price of the concurrency, not fixed.
